meta.price_rule: Program Policies §2(b) (SRC-02) permits showing price and availability only where Amazon serves the link carrying that data, or where it arrives via Creators API / PA API. Neither is connected, so no price, star rating, review count or stock status appears for any product on this site.
meta.test_rule: Nothing here was handled, cooked with, measured or tested. No product is ranked, scored or named a winner.
meta.tag_rule: Program Policies 2(b) (SRC-02) requires the Associates ID to appear as a tag parameter in the URL of each link to an Amazon Site. Every buy link on this site is therefore a destination URL of the form /dp/<ASIN>/?tag=shopnow047c-20, built from the ASIN observed on arrival. The supplied short link is kept in the record as history and is not offered as a click target, because its own tracking behaviour could not be observed.
